name: WA-02
label: Safe D

Larsen's massive fundraising advantage ($2.0M raised vs. under $9K for Feller)

model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Larsen: a D+12 seat, incumbency, and a dominant financial edge over a barely funded challenger, with markets pricing him near certain. With no polls to refine the estimate, the forecast stays close to the fundamentals-based margin of about 22 points.
model.watch: Any late surge in outside spending against Larsen or unexpected polling showing a tighter race would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Rick Larsen, a Democratic incumbent, is seeking re-election in a Washington district that leans Democratic by about 12 points. His Republican challenger, Edwin Feller, has raised less than $9,000, while Larsen has brought in over $2 million and holds a large cash advantage. No outside groups are spending against Larsen, and prediction markets give him roughly a 96% chance of winning.

No public general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on district lean, incumbency, and the money gap. All of these point the same direction, making Larsen a strong favorite, though the absence of polling leaves some room for uncertainty about the exact margin.
